purpose: Screen the locally staged HRS_sim material for an undiscovered synchronized full-loop cohort without publishing source identity, headers, timestamps or rows.

decision.primary_gap: synchronized and attested receiving-vessel or vehicle channels with controller/protocol state

claim_boundary: Header-level semantic screening plus bounded record-shape and monotonic-time checks only. Zero candidates does not prove that no qualifying data exist elsewhere; it records only this screened local material and does not validate model accuracy, safety distance or emergency response effectiveness.
